title: R-FRC-0001: SU(3) lattice gauge theory rebuilt from scratch, against published values

statements.text: A lattice gauge theory code written from scratch reproduces, at $\beta = 5.7$ to $5.9$, confinement, the gluon and color count, the static potential and the Sommer scale, the scalar glueball, the deconfinement transition, chiral symmetry breaking, the pion as a Goldstone boson, and string breaking by dynamical quarks.
statements.scope: lattice gauge theory. status simulated. category reproduction (an established result recovered, by a method brought in from outside. Worth: evidence the machinery works. Not evidence that nature uses it). depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model)
statements.conditions: Limits: nothing about the knit. It rests on none of the five assumptions. one or two couplings in 4D. Only 3D SU(2) is extrapolated to the continuum. $T_c r_0$ uses the published $r_0/a$ at the measured $\beta_c$, not an independently measured $r_0$. the $J$ parameter and $m_N/m_\rho$ (E-FRC-0091) are printed but not gated. Eight quark masses on the Edinburgh plot extrapolate to $2.04 \pm 0.20 \pm 0.19$ against the quenched continuum 1.14, with the trend running the wrong way, which a later nucleon window traces to excited states in the early nucleon. Launch gate. Pass: quantitative, auditable. Fail: prior_art_reviewed, novel, derived, differentiating, falsifiable, skeptic_reviewed, independently_reproduced. Unknown: interesting. Novelty: known. Free parameters: 0. Fitted: false. Known before: true.
statements.falsification_criteria: a reproduction failure, or a pull beyond $3\sigma$ at a second spacing
